propositions: An open or in_progress bug with a caused_by edge pointing into the epic subtree must deterministically block epic close with a teaching message (fix / re-parent / dispute link).

Candidate bugs for screening are exactly those open/in_progress bugs that are either linked to the epic subtree (any relation, any depth, bidirectional) or created after the epic's first open-to-in_progress status transition.

A forced-choice haiku screen (A: defect in epic deliverable; B: pre-existing/adjacent; C: unrelated) routes A-verdicts as compact evidence (title+citation+id, max 8 rows + overflow count) into the precheck-assembled fenced context for verifier adjudication.

The verifier blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects (A-verdicts with no store-grounded disposition: either a supersedes/duplicates link or reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose), never bare 'out of scope' or close_class.
Screen ceiling is 32 candidates evaluated; remainder recorded as unevaluated-overflow in the sidecar tally; model failures degrade to C (unrelated) and log, never blocking the close.
Screen and verifier run end-to-end through the model-class config, shared prompt cache, and overlap_verdict registration idiom (schema + normalizing validator + prompt file).
